artist.name: Antariksh Daddy
artist.bio: Antariksh Daddy is the DJ and producer name of Anandit Sachdev, a record collector and researcher based in Delhi. He started DJing in Berlin in 2015 and, after returning to India in 2018, founded Antariksh Records, a label and community project for dance music in South Asia. He has played in Germany, Egypt and Indonesia, and released the breakbeat EP Stank Face Star Sign on Antariksh Records in 2023.

eras.sound: Breakbeat dance tracks after earlier jungle-inspired rhythms
